name: warboss-marketplace
description: The warboss horde: a model-aware delegation framework that routes work down a rank ladder by residual entropy — expensive model decides, cheapest model does.

plugins.name: warboss-horde
plugins.description: Managed agent-rank ladder (WARBOSS → WARCHIEF → GRUNT) plus a /delegate doctrine that maps available models to ranks by role and routes each task to the cheapest tier that can satisfy it.
